issue_title: [Enhancement] 添加 load 缓存（带失效机制）减少重复 IO

implementation.approach: Added memory cache with mtime-based invalidation to TodoStorage
key_changes: Added _cache and _cache_mtime private attributes to TodoStorage
load() now checks mtime before reading file, returns cached data if unchanged
save() now updates cache after successful save
Cache transparent to callers - interface unchanged

acceptance_criteria_met: Consecutive load() returns cached data without re-reading file
External file modification invalidates cache and returns new data
Cache can be disabled via use_cache=False parameter

factors: Backward compatible - use_cache defaults to True
mtime-based invalidation may fail on filesystems with low mtime resolution (unlikely in practice)
Cache is in-memory only - not shared across processes
mitigations: Can disable cache for debugging/testing with use_cache=False
Cache transparently invalidates when file is modified
